chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Ghiyas from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Indeed the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) placed a turban and prayed facing it.
ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad pray facing his turban?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) placed a turban (*qalansawah*) and prayed facing it, illustrating the permissibility of using headgear as a focal point or marker during prayer. This incident is often cited by Shia jurists to discuss the conditions of *qibla* orientation and the validity of prayer when facing a specific object, emphasizing the Prophet's practical guidance on modesty and focus in worship. The hadith underscores the flexibility in Islamic jurisprudence regarding the physical orientation of the believer, provided the heart remains directed toward God.
